Event rides as per-row quality; Sample label / Sample label 2 / 'Monitoring experiment cores' comments verbatim in file
source_anomaly_disclosure: TWO source quirks preserved verbatim: (1) row 204-1245B-11H-2 carries top = 96.00 m and bottom = 7.40 m - bottom ABOVE top by 88.6 m, physically impossible for a core section; the plausible reading is that '97.40' lost its leading 9, and the archive's own geocode 51.70 = (96.00 + 7.40)/2 EXACTLY - the midpoint arithmetic faithfully propagated the typo, making the row internally consistent with its own corruption (also out of depth order between 87.56 and 112.25); detected by the bottom<top audit, carried unchanged; (2) the header abstract states the 1249F-9H3 monitoring experiment yielded '35-70 pct' while Table 1 archives 30-75 for the same core - an abstract-vs-table discrepancy in the source, both preserved verbatim, not reconciled
purpose: thirty-fourth catalogue entry - the CASCADIA MARGIN joins as region TWENTY-TWO and in-situ GAS HYDRATE CONCENTRATION is kind TWENTY-THREE: the first drilling-hazard quantity in the catalogue (hydrate dissociation destabilizes boreholes, floods logs with gas cracks, and blinds resistivity tools - the abstract's own 'biased sampling' warning about gas-crack data exclusion is preserved in the file), measured by resistivity petrophysics - the same physical channel this product's wireline simulations carry; the summit-vs-flanks structure is re-derived by the gate: every interval outside Site 1249 and the 1248C-4X-1 experiment is <= 15 pct while the southern-summit intervals reach 55-75
verified: 32 rows / 172 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT, closing only with the 9 second-labels + 3 comment cells); geocode = (top+bottom)/2 re-derived on ALL 32 rows within 0.005 m (including the corrupted 11H-2 row - the archive is consistent with its own typo); exactly ONE bottom<top row (the disclosed typo); min <= max hydrate on all rows; the three monitoring cores match the abstract's design; all 25 non-summit background rows at min = 0 and max <= 15; abstract-vs-table discrepancy disclosed; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
